notes: Region: northern single-crop (Inner Mongolia, Heilongjiang, Gansu) & southwest (Sichuan, Guizhou). Per-mu: N 9.0-12.0, P2O5 5.0-7.0, K2O 8.0-12.0 kg/mu. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 50% N/K2O as basal in planting furrow; remaining N and K2O at earthing-up/tuber initiation via drip or side-dress. SOP strictly preferred for starch content.
applicationTiming: 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O at planting (0 DAP). 50% N + 50% K2O at earthing-up/tuber initiation (30-40 DAP).

source.organization: MARA; IVF-CAAS
source.title: Carrot NPK recommendation China

notes: Region: Shandong, Hebei, Inner Mongolia, Fujian. Per-mu: N 6.7-8.7, P2O5 3.3-5.0, K2O 8.0-11.3 kg/mu. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 1/3 K2O as basal; N and remaining K2O in 2 splits at post-thinning and root bulking. High K for root shape and carotene.
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 DAS). Post-thinning (30-35 DAS). Peak root bulking (60-70 DAS).

source.organization: SAAS; MARA
source.title: Spinach NPK recommendation China

notes: Region: northern open fields (Shandong, Henan) & southern winter fields. Per-mu: N 5.3-7.3, P2O5 2.7-3.7, K2O 3.3-5.0 kg/mu. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, K2O and 50% N as basal (jifei) incorporated; remaining N at 4-5 leaf stage via water-run top-dress. Stop N 15 days before harvest.
applicationTiming: 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O at sowing (0 DAS). 50% N at 20-25 DAS (vigorous growth stage).

source.organization: MARA; Guizhou Academy of Agricultural Sciences
source.title: Pepper NPK recommendation China

notes: Region: Guizhou, Hunan, Henan, Shandong, Hebei. N open-field 150-200; solar greenhouse up to 250. Per-mu: P2O5 4.7-6.7, K2O 8.7-12.0 kg/mu. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 30% N/K2O as basal; remaining N and K2O in 3 post-transplant splits via fertigation/water-run.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). First flower (25-30 DAT): 20% N + 20% K2O. Peak fruiting 1 (50-55 DAT): 25% N + 25% K2O. Peak fruiting 2 (75-80 DAT): 25% N + 25% K2O.

source.organization: SAAS; Jinxiang Garlic Research Institute
source.title: Garlic NPK recommendation China

notes: Region: Shandong (Jinxiang, Cangshan), Henan (Qi County), Jiangsu (Pizhou). Per-mu: N 10.7-13.3, P2O5 4.7-6.0, K2O 7.3-10.0 kg/mu. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, Sulphur and 1/3 N/K2O as basal at autumn planting; remaining splits at spring green-up and bolting. No late N after bulb swelling (rot risk). Sulphur for allicin/pungency.
applicationTiming: Basal at planting, October (0 DAP). Spring green-up (late Feb/early Mar): 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O. Bolt elongation/bulb swelling (mid-Apr): 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O.

source.organization: Kumamoto Prefectural Agricultural Research Center; NARO Institute of Vegetable and Floriculture Science
source.title: Tomato NPK recommendation Japan

notes: Region: Kumamoto, Hokkaido, Aichi, Tochigi. Greenhouse high-wire rockwool/hydroponic up to 300 kg/ha N. Per-10a: N 18.0-24.0, P2O5 14.0-20.0, K2O 18.0-26.0 kg/10a. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Soil mulch drip culture: apply 25% N, all P, and 25% K as basal (genpi). Inject 75% N and K via drip fertigation (tenteki kansui sehi) at weekly intervals from 3rd truss flowering (dai-3 dan kaika-ki) through peak ripening (shukaku saisei-ki). High potash supports Brix, fruit firmness, and blossom-end rot control.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT): 25% N + 100% P2O5 + 25% K2O. Top-dressing: from 3rd truss fruit set / dai-3 dan chakka-ki (30-35 DAT); 75% N and K2O split weekly through harvest.

source.organization: Kochi Prefectural Agricultural Research Center; NARO
source.title: Eggplant (nasu) NPK recommendation Japan

notes: Region: Kochi, Gunma, Fukuoka, Niigata. Protected long-term cropping up to 350 kg/ha N. Per-10a: N 22.0-30.0, P2O5 14.0-20.0, K2O 18.0-25.0 kg/10a. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 25% N/K2O as basal (genpi). Deliver remaining N and K continuously through harvest end via drip fertigation (tenteki sehi) or fortnightly top-dressings, balanced.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT): 25% N + 100% P2O5 + 25% K2O. Top-dressing: continuous fertigation from first fruit harvest / shukaku kaishi-go; remaining 75% N and K2O evenly divided at 2-week intervals across 50-120 DAT.

source.organization: Ibaraki Prefectural Agriculture Center; Miyazaki ARES
source.title: Sweet green pepper (piman) NPK recommendation Japan

notes: Region: Ibaraki (Kamisu/Kashima), Miyazaki, Kochi, Kagoshima. Greenhouse/pipe-house up to 320 kg/ha N. Per-10a: N 22.0-28.0, P2O5 13.0-18.0, K2O 18.0-24.0 kg/10a. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 25% N/K2O as basal (genpi). Deliver remaining N and K through the continuous harvest period via drip fertigation (tenteki tube) or periodic top-dressings at 15-20 day intervals.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT): 25% N + 100% P2O5 + 25% K2O. Top-dressing: commencing at early harvest stage (30-35 DAT); remaining 75% N and K2O split in 4-5 equal applications across 40-120 DAT.

source.organization: Gunma Prefectural Agricultural Technology Center; Aichi ARES
source.title: Cabbage (kyabetsu) NPK recommendation Japan

notes: Region: Aichi (winter), Gunma/Tsumagoi highland (summer), Chiba (spring). Per-10a: N 18.0-23.0, P2O5 12.0-17.0, K2O 14.0-19.0 kg/10a. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 1/2 K2O basal; apply N and remaining K2O in two splits so that kekkyu (head compaction) is firm and cracking does not occur.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT): 40% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O. Top-dress 1: post-transplant establishment (20-25 DAT): 30% N + 25% K2O. Top-dress 2: head formation initiation / kekkyu shoki (45-50 DAT): 30% N + 25% K2O.

source.organization: Yamagata Prefecture Agriculture Dept
source.title: Nosakumotsu no sehi kijun (fertilization standards, 2019)

notes: Hakusai 8,000 kg/10a Yamagata Prefectural Fertilization Standard: Autumn-harvest Chinese Cabbage (Aki-dori Hakusai), 25.1/29.2/22.9 kg/10a (x10 = 251/292/229 kg/ha). Heavy Kuroboku/volcanic soils drive P demand above N.
applicationMethod: Basal / Motogoe (0 DAT): 60% N (150.6 kg/ha) + 100% P2O5 (292 kg/ha) + 60% K2O (137.4 kg/ha) incorporated with mulch and ridge formation at transplanting. Top-dress / Oibai (20-25 DAT, heading initiation): remaining 40% N (100.4 kg/ha) + 40% K2O (91.6 kg/ha) via furrow/hole placement between plants, followed by irrigation.
applicationTiming: 0 DAT: basal (60% N + full P + 60% K). 20-25 DAT: top-dress (40% N + 40% K) at heading initiation.

source.organization: Chiba Prefectural Agriculture Research Center; NARO
source.title: Spinach (horenso) NPK recommendation Japan

notes: Region: Kanto Plain (Saitama, Chiba, Ibaraki), Gunma. Nitrate guidelines strictly cap N; high P compensates Kuroboku/Andosol fixation. Per-10a: N 8.0-11.0, P2O5 8.0-12.0, K2O 7.0-10.0 kg/10a. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Short 30-45 day cycle. Mix 100% of fertilizer into beds before sowing (zenryo genpi) using slow-release compound fertilizer (hifuku fukugo hiryo) or standard granular.
applicationTiming: 100% basal pre-sowing (0 DAS / hashu-zen zenryo seyo).

source.organization: Hokkaido Research Organization (HRO Kitami Agricultural Experiment Station); Hyogo Prefectural Technology Center for Agriculture
source.title: Onion (tamanegi) NPK recommendation Japan

notes: Region: Hokkaido (Kitami/Tokachi, spring sown), Hyogo (Awaji Island, autumn sown), Saga. Kuroboku high P demand. Per-10a: N 15.0-19.0, P2O5 15.0-22.0, K2O 12.0-16.0 kg/10a. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Hokkaido (spring sown): apply 100% full basal at transplanting using coated slow-release urea (hiko chosei-gata hifuku nyoso). Awaji/Honshu (autumn sown): apply all P2O5 and 1/3 N/K2O as basal (genpi); split remaining N and K2O at spring recovery in two applications (shihi: halt all N by late March to prevent thick necks and soft rots).
applicationTiming: Hokkaido: 100% basal at transplanting (late April / 0 DAT). Honshu (autumn): basal (November) + 1st top-dress (mid-February) + 2nd top-dress (mid-March; no N after March).

source.organization: Kanagawa Prefectural Agricultural Technology Center; Chiba ARES
source.title: Daikon radish NPK recommendation Japan

notes: Region: Chiba, Kanagawa (Miura Peninsula), Hokkaido, Kagoshima. Per-10a: N 12.0-15.0, P2O5 10.0-14.0, K2O 11.0-15.0 kg/10a. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Incorporate all P2O5, Boron, and 1/2 N/K2O into raised ridges (taka-une) as basal (genpi). Side-dress remaining N and K2O after thinning (mabiki).
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 DAS): 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O + 100% Boron. Top-dress: post-thinning / 2nd thinning (20-25 DAS): 50% N + 50% K2O.

source.organization: Chiba Prefectural ARES; Hokkaido Research Organization (HRO)
source.title: Carrot (ninjin) NPK recommendation Japan

notes: Region: Chiba (Tomisato), Hokkaido (Tokachi), Tokushima. Per-10a: N 11.0-14.0, P2O5 12.0-16.0, K2O 12.0-16.0 kg/10a. High potash for root smoothness and uniform color. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 1/2 K2O basal; apply N and remaining K2O in two splits at thinning and root bulking (konbu hidai).
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 DAS): 40% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O. Top-dress 1: post-thinning / mabiki-go (30-35 DAS): 30% N + 25% K2O. Top-dress 2: root bulking / hidai-ki (55-65 DAS): 30% N + 25% K2O.

source.organization: Gunma Prefectural Agricultural Technology Center; Aichi ARES
source.title: Cabbage (kyabetsu) NPK recommendation Japan

notes: Region: Aichi (winter), Gunma/Tsumagoi highland (summer), Chiba (spring). Per-10a: N 18.0-23.0, P2O5 12.0-17.0, K2O 14.0-19.0 kg/10a. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 1/2 K2O basal; apply N and remaining K2O in two splits so that kekkyu (head compaction) is firm and cracking does not occur.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT): 40% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O. Top-dress 1: post-transplant establishment (20-25 DAT): 30% N + 25% K2O. Top-dress 2: head formation initiation / kekkyu shoki (45-50 DAT): 30% N + 25% K2O.

source.organization: RDA NIHHS (토마토 수경재배 및 양액처방기준); Buyeo Tomato Experiment Station
source.title: Tomato NPK recommendation South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Region: Chungnam (Buyeo), Gangwon (Hwacheon, Chuncheon), Gyeongnam (Gimhae).
applicationMethod: Apply 25% N, all P2O5, and 25% K2O as basal on beds. Deliver 75% N and K via drip fertigation from 1st truss flowering through continuous harvesting. High potash supports Brix and blossom-end rot control.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). 1st truss flowering and fruit setting (20-30 DAT). 3rd truss fruit sizing to peak ripening (45-90 DAT; fertigate weekly).

source.organization: RDA Standard Fertilization Manual / Highland Agriculture Research Institute
source.title: Gochu (chili, Gangwon highland) NPK — South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: 40% N, full P, 40% K basal under vinyl. Remaining N and K in two furrow top-dressings.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting. Top-dressings at 30 DAT and 60 DAT.

source.organization: OI Pomodoro Nord Italia; Emilia-Romagna; ANICAV
source.title: Tomato NPK recommendation Italy (Emilia-Romagna/Campania/Puglia)

notes: Region: Emilia-Romagna/Piacenza/Parma (industria Nord), Campania/Puglia (Sud). Processing tomato N 160-210 kg/ha; fresh table (mensa) 180-240 kg/ha. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: 20% N + full P + 20% K as basal; 80% N and K via drip fertigation during flowering and ripening. High potash for dry matter/Brix and fruit consistency.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Rooting and vegetative growth (15-30 DAT). Flowering and fruit set (35-60 DAT). Fruit enlargement and ripening (60-90 DAT).

source.organization: Consorzio Cipolla di Medicina; Emilia-Romagna
source.title: Onion NPK recommendation Italy (Emilia-Romagna/Calabria/Veneto)

notes: Region: Emilia-Romagna (Medicina), Calabria (Tropea IGP), Veneto. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: All P2O5, 1/3 K2O and 20% N as basal; remaining N and K2O in two equal coperture. Stop all late N at bulb swelling to prevent thick necks (collo grosso) and rots.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting/sowing (0 DAT). Copertura 1: 4-leaf stage (30-35 DAT). Copertura 2: bulb swelling start (55-65 DAT; halt all N 30 days before harvest).

source.organization: Emilia-Romagna Disciplinari; Bologna DOP
source.title: Potato NPK recommendation Italy (Emilia-Romagna/Campania/Calabria)

notes: Region: Emilia-Romagna (Bologna DOP), Campania, Calabria (Sila IGP). SOP (Solfato di Potassio) strictly preferred for specific gravity. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 50% N and K2O at planting (furrow ridging); remaining N and K2O at earthing-up (rincalzatura) or tuber initiation via side-dress/fertigation.
applicationTiming: 50% N + all P2O5 + 50% K2O at planting (0 DAP). 50% N + 50% K2O at earthing-up / tuber initiation (25-35 DAP).

source.organization: Regione Abruzzo; Regione Veneto
source.title: Carrot NPK recommendation Italy (Fucino IGP/Chioggia/Sicilia)

notes: Region: Abruzzo (Fucino), Veneto (Chioggia), Sicilia (Ispica IGP). High potash for root collar strength and deep orange color. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 1/3 K2O as basal; N and remaining K2O in two splits via side-dress/fertigation.
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 DAS). Split 1: post-thinning stage (30-35 DAS). Split 2: taproot swelling (55-70 DAS).

source.organization: Regione Campania; Regione Veneto
source.title: Cauliflower NPK recommendation Italy (Campania/Puglia/Veneto/Marche)

notes: Region: Campania, Puglia, Veneto, Marche. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: All P2O5, Boron and 25% N/K2O as basal; remaining N and K2O in two equal splits via copertura or fertigation.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Copertura 1: 25 days after transplanting (vegetative growth). Copertura 2: curd initiation stage (45-55 DAT).

source.organization: Veneto Disciplinari; CREA
source.title: Cabbage NPK recommendation Italy (Veneto/Emilia-Romagna/Piemonte)

notes: Region: Veneto, Emilia-Romagna, Piemonte. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: P and K as basal; N in two equal post-transplant doses so the head (palla) forms compact without cracking.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Copertura 1: 20-25 days after transplanting. Copertura 2: head closure stage (40-50 DAT).

source.organization: Emilia-Romagna Disciplinari; CREA-CI
source.title: Peas NPK recommendation Italy (Emilia-Romagna/Veneto/Puglia)

notes: Region: Emilia-Romagna, Veneto, Puglia. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: 100% fertilizer at sowing as basal (concimazione di fondo), localized near seed. Excess nitrogen avoided to prevent lodging and botrytis risk.
applicationTiming: 100% basal at sowing (0 DAS). Starter dose only; symbiotic N2-fixation via root nodules.

source.organization: CREA-OF; Regione Campania
source.title: Pepper NPK recommendation Italy (Campania/Sicilia/Piemonte/Puglia)

notes: Region: Campania, Sicilia, Piemonte (Carmagnola), Puglia. Open field N 140-190 kg/ha; greenhouse up to 230 kg/ha. Covers sweet pepper and chili (Capsicum annuum). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Full P and 20% N/K as basal; remaining N and K via drip fertigation balanced across flowering and fruit enlargement. Greenhouse high yield: up to 230 kg/ha N.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Initial vegetative phase (20-35 DAT). Fruit set and enlargement (40-95 DAT).

source.organization: Regione Sicilia; CREA-OF
source.title: Eggplant NPK recommendation Italy (Sicilia/Campania/Puglia)

notes: Region: Sicilia (Vittoria/Ragusa), Campania, Puglia. Open field N 140-180 kg/ha; greenhouse up to 240 kg/ha. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Drip plasticulture: basal dose of 20% N, full P, 25% K; remaining N and K injected weekly via fertigation with flowering and fruit picking flushes. Greenhouse high-yield: up to 240 kg/ha N.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Vegetative to flowering ramp-up (25-45 DAT). Continuous harvest production (50-100 DAT).

source.organization: Emilia-Romagna Disciplinari; ARPA Lazio
source.title: Spinach NPK recommendation Italy (Emilia-Romagna/Lazio/Puglia)

notes: Region: Emilia-Romagna, Agro Pontino (Lazio), Puglia. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: All P2O5, K2O and 40% N as basal; remaining N as top-dress (copertura) at rosette stage. N limits per disciplinari to prevent nitrate accumulation in leaves.
applicationTiming: 40% N + all P2O5 + all K2O at sowing (0 DAS). 60% N at active growth phase (20-25 DAS; halt 15 days before cutting).

source.organization: CREA-OF; Regione Lazio
source.title: Radish NPK recommendation Italy (Lazio/Campania greenhouses)

notes: Region: Agro Pontino (Lazio), Campania. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Fast 20-28 day cycle. 100% fertilizer integrated in bed preparation before sowing.
applicationTiming: 100% basal pre-sowing (0 DAS).

source.organization: LWK Nordrhein-Westfalen (Sollwerte fuer Gemüsebau DueV); LfL Bayern
source.title: Cauliflower NPK recommendation Germany

notes: Region: Rheinland (Bornheim/Straelen), Dithmarschen, Bayern. Germany: N is the N-Sollwert (total target crop N demand including soil Nmin; DuV requires subtracting mineralized soil nitrate-N). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, Boron and 1/3 N/K2O before transplanting (Grundduengung); split the remaining N and K2O in two top-dress applications (Kopfduengung). Boron prevents hollow stem (Hohlstrunk).
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT): 1/3 N + 100% P2O5 + 1/3 K2O. Top-dress (rosette stage, 20-25 DAT): 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O. Top-dress (curd initiation, 45-50 DAT): 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O.

source.organization: Landwirtschaftskammer Schleswig-Holstein; KTBL Freilandgemüsebau
source.title: Cabbage NPK recommendation Germany

notes: Region: Dithmarschen (Schleswig-Holstein - Europe's largest cabbage region), NRW. For solid heading without bursting. Germany: N is the N-Sollwert (total target crop N demand including soil Nmin; DuV requires subtracting mineralized soil nitrate-N). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 1/2 K2O as basal (Grundduengung); apply N and the remaining K2O in two post-transplant splits.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT): 40% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O. Top-dress (active vegetative stage, 25-30 DAT): 30% N + 25% K2O. Top-dress (head initiation, 50-60 DAT): 30% N + 25% K2O.

formula: N is a DüV legal maximum (Bedarfswert), not a trial-optimal dose; P/K by Gehaltsklasse where available

source.organization: KTBL Datensammlung Freilandgemüsebau / DLR Rheinpfalz
source.title: Chinakohl (chinese cabbage) NPK — Germany

notes: N values are N-Sollwert under DüV (soil Nmin deducted). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: 50% N + full P/K basal. 50% N side-dressed 3-4 weeks post-planting.
applicationTiming: Basal at planting. Side-dress 3-4 weeks post-planting.

source.organization: LWK Niedersachsen (Fachinformation Moehrenanbau); KTBL
source.title: Carrot NPK recommendation Germany

notes: Region: Niedersachsen (Lueneburger Heide), NRW, Pfalz, Bayern. N-Sollwert strictly controlled to avoid cavity spot and split roots; high potash for root smoothness and storage quality. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 1/2 K2O at ridge bedding (Dammfraesen); apply N and the remaining K2O at thinning and during root bulking (Dickenwachstum).
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 DAS): 35% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O. Top-dress (post-emergence / 4-leaf stage, 30-35 DAS): 35% N + 25% K2O. Top-dress (root bulking, 60-70 DAS): 30% N + 25% K2O.

source.organization: LfL Bayern (Zwiebelanbau in Bayern); DLR Rheinpfalz
source.title: Onion NPK recommendation Germany

notes: Region: Bayern (Knoblauchsland), Pfalz, Hessen, Sachsen-Anhalt. Germany: N is the N-Sollwert (total target crop N demand including soil Nmin; DuV requires subtracting mineralized soil nitrate-N). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 1/3 K2O as basal (Grundduengung); apply N and the remaining K2O in 2-3 splits (Kopfduengung). Stop all late N once bulbing starts to avoid thick necks (Dickhalsigkeit) and rots.
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing/transplanting (0 DAS/DAT): 30% N + 100% P2O5 + 33% K2O. Top-dress (3-4 leaf stage, 30-35 DAS/DAT): 35% N + 33% K2O. Top-dress (bulbing start, 55-65 DAS/DAT; halt all N 30 days before harvest): 35% N + 34% K2O.

source.organization: LWK Nordrhein-Westfalen (Duengehinweise Spinat); DLR Rheinpfalz
source.title: Spinach NPK recommendation Germany

notes: Region: Rheinland (NRW - major processing hub), Muensterland, Pfalz. N-Sollwert strictly regulated to prevent leaf nitrate accumulation. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, K2O and 50% N during seedbed preparation (Saatbettbereitung); apply the remaining N at the 4-6 leaf stage as top-dress (Kopfduengung).
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 DAS): 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O. Top-dress (18-22 DAS): 50% N (cut-off at least 14 days before harvest).

source.organization: DLR Rheinpfalz (Knoblauchanbau Leitfaden); KTBL
source.title: Garlic NPK recommendation Germany

notes: Region: Pfalz, Baden-Wuerttemberg, Hessen. Sulphur for allicin synthesis. Germany: N is the N-Sollwert (total target crop N demand including soil Nmin; DuV requires subtracting mineralized soil nitrate-N). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, Sulphur and 1/3 N/K2O at autumn planting; apply the remaining N and K2O in two equal splits at spring regrowth. Stop all N once bulb swelling starts.
applicationTiming: Basal at planting (October/November, 0 DAP). Top-dress (spring regrowth, late Feb/early Mar): 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O. Top-dress (pre bulb differentiation, mid-April; halt 30 days before harvest): 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O.

source.organization: DLR Rheinpfalz (Gemüsebau Aktuell); DueV Richtwerte
source.title: Radish NPK recommendation Germany

notes: Region: Rheinland-Pfalz (Vorderpfalz), Baden-Wuerttemberg. Short 25-35 day crop. Germany: N is the N-Sollwert (total target crop N demand including soil Nmin; DuV requires subtracting mineralized soil nitrate-N). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Incorporate 100% of NPK as basal (Grundduengung) during seedbed preparation (Kurzkultur).
applicationTiming: 100% basal pre-sowing (0 DAS).

source.organization: LWK Niedersachsen; KTBL Datensammlung Gemüsebau
source.title: Peas NPK recommendation Germany

notes: Region: Niedersachsen, Sachsen-Anhalt, Bayern. Starter N only (symbiotic rhizobial N-fixation); excess N legally restricted under DueV for legumes. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply 100% of fertilizer as basal (Grundduengung) localized below the seed furrow before sowing. DueV restricts excess N for legumes to avoid blocking root nodulation.
applicationTiming: 100% basal pre-sowing (0 DAS).

source.organization: LWK Niedersachsen (Kartoffelbau Leitfaden); LfL Bayern
source.title: Potato NPK recommendation Germany

notes: Region: Niedersachsen (Uelzen, Lueneburg), Bayern, NRW. N strictly regulated under DueV to maintain tuber dry matter and prevent scab; Kaliumsulfat/Patentkali preferred (chloride degrades starch/processing quality). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 50% N/K2O at bed ridging/planting (Dammformung); apply the remaining N and K2O at earthing-up (Haeufeln) or tuber initiation.
applicationTiming: Basal at planting (0 DAP): 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O. Top-dress at earthing-up/tuber initiation (25-35 DAP): 50% N + 50% K2O.

source.organization: CTIFL; SONITO (Societe Nationale Interprofessionnelle de la Tomate)
source.title: Tomato NPK recommendation France

notes: Region: PACA / Vallee du Rhone, Nouvelle-Aquitaine (Marmande - frais), Sud-Ouest (industrie). France: N values are total crop nutritional target doses (COMIFER bilan previsionnel X kg/ha); soil mineral reserve (Ri / reliquat azote sortie hiver) must be subtracted per COMIFER/Nitrates Directive. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). N variants: 160-210 open field industry; 220-270 under shelter (sous abri hors-sol/sol frais).
applicationMethod: Apply 20% N + full P + 20% K as basal (au fond); inject 80% N and K via fertigation weekly from 1st-truss flowering through fruit enlargement and ripening (maturation). High potash for Brix, fruit firmness and blossom-end rot (necrose apicale) control.
applicationTiming: Fumure de fond at transplanting (0 DAT). Rooting and 1st-truss flowering (15-30 DAT). Fruit enlargement and full harvest (35-95 DAT).

source.organization: CTIFL; Chambre d'Agriculture du Loiret
source.title: Onion NPK recommendation France

notes: Region: Centre-Val de Loire (Beauce), Grand Est (Champagne), Nouvelle-Aquitaine. France: N values are total crop nutritional target doses (COMIFER bilan previsionnel X kg/ha); soil mineral reserve (Ri / reliquat azote sortie hiver) must be subtracted per COMIFER/Nitrates Directive. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply 30% N + full P + 33% K2O as basal (fumure de fond); split the remaining N and K2O in two fractions. Stop all late N once bulbification begins to prevent thick necks (collets epais) and storage rots (pourritures de conservation).
applicationTiming: Fumure de fond at sowing/transplanting (0 DAS/DAT): 30% N + 100% P2O5 + 33% K2O. 1st top-dress (3-4 leaf stage, 30-35 DAS/DAT): 35% N + 33% K2O. 2nd top-dress (bulbification onset, 55-65 DAS/DAT; halt all N 30 days before harvest): 35% N + 34% K2O.

source.organization: ARVALIS - Institut du vegetal; COMIFER
source.title: Potato NPK recommendation France

notes: Region: Hauts-de-France, Picardie, Champagne-Ardenne. France: N values are total crop nutritional target doses (COMIFER bilan previsionnel X kg/ha); soil mineral reserve (Ri / reliquat azote sortie hiver) must be subtracted per COMIFER/Nitrates Directive. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 50% N/K2O at ridge planting (plantation/buttage); apply the remaining N and K2O at earthing-up / tuber initiation. Sulfate de potasse strictly preferred to preserve dry matter (matiere seche). N per COMIFER bilan previsionnel method.
applicationTiming: Fumure de fond at planting (0 DAP): 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O. Top-dress at earthing-up / tuber initiation (25-35 DAP): 50% N + 50% K2O.

source.organization: CTIFL; Chambre d'Agriculture Nouvelle-Aquitaine
source.title: Carrot NPK recommendation France

notes: Region: Nouvelle-Aquitaine (Landes sand belt), Normandie (Creances), Bretagne. France: N values are total crop nutritional target doses (COMIFER bilan previsionnel X kg/ha); soil mineral reserve (Ri / reliquat azote sortie hiver) must be subtracted per COMIFER/Nitrates Directive. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 1/2 K2O at ridge formation (confection des buttes); split N and the remaining K2O at thinning (eclaircissage) and root bulking (grossissement). N is capped to prevent forking, cavity spot and root splitting; high potash for root skin finish and storage quality.
applicationTiming: Fumure de fond at sowing (0 DAS): 35% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O. 1st top-dress (3-4 leaf stage, 30-35 DAS): 35% N + 25% K2O. 2nd top-dress (root bulking / grossissement racinaire, 60-70 DAS): 30% N + 25% K2O.

source.organization: Chambre d'Agriculture de Bretagne; CTIFL
source.title: Spinach NPK recommendation France

notes: Region: Bretagne (Finistere, Morbihan), Hauts-de-France. France: N values are total crop nutritional target doses (COMIFER bilan previsionnel X kg/ha); soil mineral reserve (Ri / reliquat azote sortie hiver) must be subtracted per COMIFER/Nitrates Directive. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, K2O and 50% N in seedbed preparation; top-dress the remaining N at the 4-5 leaf stage (apport de couverture). N threshold strictly regulated per COMIFER to avoid petiole nitrate accumulation.
applicationTiming: Fumure de fond at sowing (0 DAS): 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O. Top-dress (18-22 DAS): 50% N (halt at least 15 days before cutting).

source.organization: Chambre d'Agriculture de Bretagne; CTIFL
source.title: Cauliflower NPK recommendation France

France: N values are total crop nutritional target doses (COMIFER bilan previsionnel X kg/ha); soil mineral reserve (Ri / reliquat azote sortie hiver) must be subtracted per COMIFER/Nitrates Directive. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, Boron and 1/3 N/K2O before transplanting (fumure de fond); split the remaining N and K2O in two top-dress applications. Boron prevents hollow stem (moelle creuse).
applicationTiming: Fumure de fond (0 DAT): 1/3 N + 100% P2O5 + 1/3 K2O. 1st top-dress (rosette stage, 25-30 DAT): 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O. 2nd top-dress (curd induction / initiation de la pomme, 50-55 DAT): 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O.

applicationTiming: Fumure de fond at transplanting (0 DAT). Early vegetative phase (15-35 DAT). Flowering, fruit setting and maturation (40-100 DAT).

applicationTiming: Fumure de fond at transplanting (0 DAT). Vegetative growth (20-40 DAT). Flowering and continuous harvest (45-100 DAT; regular applications).
