applicationMethod: P and K as basal in planting holes; N in three equal splits due to long picking period.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N at transplanting (0 HST). 1/3 N 25-30 days after transplanting (25-30 HST, early flowering). 1/3 N 50-55 days after transplanting (50-55 HST, harvest period).

source.organization: Balitsa Lembang; Program Swasembada Bawang Putih Ditjen Hortikultura
source.title: Garlic NPK recommendation Indonesia

notes: Region: Highland sub-districts (Temanggung, Sembalun Lombok, Tawangmangu). Bawang putih. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, K2O, sulphur and 1/3 N in beds before mulch; remaining N in splits. Stop N 30 days before harvest.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N at planting (0 HST). 1/3 N 25-30 days after planting (25-30 HST). 1/3 N 50-55 days after planting (50-55 HST, bulb formation).

source.organization: Balai Penelitian Tanaman Sayuran (Balitsa), Lembang
source.title: Potato NPK recommendation Indonesia

notes: Region: Highland Java & Sumatra (Pangalengan, Dieng, Kerinci). Granola/Atlantic varieties. High P for acid volcanic Andisols; SOP preferred for K. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 50% N and K2O in furrows at planting. Remaining N and K2O side-dressed at earthing-up (pembubunan).
applicationTiming: 50% N + 50% K2O at planting (0 HST). 50% N + 50% K2O 30-35 days after planting (30-35 HST, tuber initiation).

source.organization: Balitsa Lembang; Ditjen Hortikultura SOP Cabai
source.title: Chili NPK recommendation Indonesia

notes: Region: All regions (Kediri, Brebes, Magelang, Medan). Cabai merah / cabai rawit. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 1/3 K2O as basal under plastic mulch; N and remaining K2O in 3 splits via kocoran (fertigation/drenching) or fertilizer holes.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O at transplanting (0 HST). 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O 25-30 days after transplanting (25-30 HST, active vegetative). 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O 50-60 days after transplanting (50-60 HST, flowering & fruiting).

source.organization: Balitsa Lembang; Balai Besar Pengkajian dan Pengembangan Teknologi Pertanian (BBP2TP)
source.title: Shallot NPK recommendation Indonesia

notes: Region: Brebes, Nganjuk, Enrekang, Bima. Bawang merah = shallot (Allium cepa var. aggregatum), not bulb onion. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 50% K2O as basal; N and remaining K2O in two equal side-dress/kocoran splits. No N after 35 HST.
applicationTiming: 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O at planting (0 HST). 50% N 10-15 days after planting (10-15 HST). 50% N + 50% K2O 25-30 days after planting (25-30 HST, bulb formation).

source.organization: Balai Penelitian Tanaman Sayuran (Balitsa), Lembang
source.title: Tomato NPK recommendation Indonesia

notes: Region: Highland & lowland Java/Sumatra. Tomat. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 40% K2O as basal in beds; N and remaining K2O in splits to keep fruit firmness and control blossom end rot.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N + 40% K2O at transplanting (0 HST). 1/3 N + 30% K2O 20-25 days after transplanting (20-25 HST). 1/3 N + 30% K2O 45-50 days after transplanting (45-50 HST, fruit enlargement).

source.organization: NIHORT Ibadan; IAR Samaru, Zaria
source.title: Okra NPK recommendation Nigeria (Rainforest & Guinea Savanna)

notes: Region: Nationwide (Rainforest & Guinea Savanna). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). SSP and MOP basis.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, all K2O, and 1/2 N applied 2 weeks after sowing at thinning/weeding via ring or band placement (5-8 cm from stem). Remaining N side-dressed at flowering.
applicationTiming: 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O at 14 DAS. 50% N at 35-42 DAS (flowering stage).

source.organization: IAR Samaru Legume Program; NIHORT Jos Sub-Station
source.title: Peas NPK recommendation Nigeria (Middle Belt & Jos Plateau)

notes: Region: Middle Belt & Jos Plateau. Starter N dose only; legume fixes atmospheric N. Excess N causes vine growth, no pods.
applicationMethod: 100% NPK incorporated in furrow 5 cm below seed at planting. Excess nitrogen causes vegetative vines and no pods.
applicationTiming: 100% basal at planting (0 DAS).

source.organization: NIHORT Vegetable Production Guide; FUNAAB
source.title: African Spinach/Amaranth NPK recommendation Nigeria

notes: Region: Peri-urban Southern rainforest & Fadama lowlands. African spinach (Amaranthus cruentus / Celosia argentea).
applicationMethod: All P2O5, all K2O, and 1/2 N basal at bed preparation. Remaining N side-dressed after first vegetative harvesting/cutting.
applicationTiming: 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O at transplanting/emergence (0-7 DAT). 50% N after first cutting (21-25 DAT).

source.organization: NIHORT Bagauda / Jos Plateau Sub-Station; Plateau State ADP
source.title: Cauliflower NPK recommendation Nigeria (Jos Plateau)

notes: Region: Jos Plateau (highland cold belt). Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, all K2O, Boron, and 1/3 N at transplanting. Remaining N in two equal side-dress splits.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N at transplanting (0 DAT). 1/3 N at 21 DAT. 1/3 N at curd initiation (42-45 DAT).

source.organization: IAR Samaru, Zaria; NIHORT Jos Station
source.title: Cabbage NPK recommendation Nigeria (Jos Plateau, Kano & Kaduna Fadama)

notes: Region: Jos Plateau, Kano & Kaduna irrigated Fadama. Split N prevents head cracking.
applicationMethod: P and K basal in beds; N split three ways for compact head formation without cracking.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N at transplanting (0 DAT). 1/3 N at 21-25 DAT. 1/3 N at 40-45 DAT (head formation).

source.organization: NIHORT Ibadan / Jos Sub-Station
source.title: Radish NPK recommendation Nigeria (Jos Plateau & Northern river valleys)

notes: Region: Jos Plateau & Northern river valleys.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, all K2O, and 1/2 N on seedbed ridges at sowing. Remaining N side-dressed at root swelling.
applicationTiming: 50% N at sowing (0 DAS). 50% N at 18-21 DAS (post-emergence).

source.organization: IAR Samaru, Zaria; KNARDA
source.title: Carrot NPK recommendation Nigeria (Kano, Kaduna, Plateau / Fadama)

notes: Region: Northern States (Kano, Kaduna, Plateau / Fadama). High potash for root elongation and sweetness.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, all K2O, and 1/2 N incorporated in raised beds basal. Remaining N immediately after thinning.
applicationTiming: 50% N at sowing (0 DAS). 50% N at 28-30 DAS (post-thinning).

source.organization: NIHORT Horticultural Series; UNN Nsukka
source.title: African Eggplant/Brinjal NPK recommendation Nigeria (nationwide)

notes: Region: Nationwide (South-East, South-West & Middle Belt). Solanum aethiopicum / S. melongena.
applicationMethod: Full P and K basal on transplants. N in three splits due to long harvesting period.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N at transplanting (0 DAT). 1/3 N at 3-4 weeks (early flowering). 1/3 N after first major harvest (fruiting continuation).

source.organization: IAR Samaru, Zaria; SADP Sokoto
source.title: Garlic NPK recommendation Nigeria (Northern Fadama: Kano, Sokoto, Kebbi)

notes: Region: Northern Fadama (Kano, Sokoto, Kebbi). Stop N 30 days before harvest.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, all K2O, Sulphur, and 1/2 N basal at clod planting; remaining N before bulb formation. Stop N 30 days before harvest.
applicationTiming: 50% N at planting (0 DAS). 50% N at 30-35 DAS (vegetative flush).

source.organization: NRCRI Potato Sub-Station, Kuru/Vom (Plateau State)
source.title: Irish Potato NPK recommendation Nigeria (Jos Plateau)

notes: Region: Jos Plateau (Bokkos, Mangu, Barkin Ladi). MOP/SOP basis.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 50% N and 50% K2O in planting mounds/ridges; remaining N and K2O side-dressed at earthing-up.
applicationTiming: 50% N + 50% K2O at planting (0 DAS). 50% N + 50% K2O at 28-30 DAS (earthing-up & tuber initiation).

source.organization: NIHORT Vegetable Program, Ibadan; IAR Samaru
source.title: Hot Pepper NPK recommendation Nigeria (Kano, Kaduna, Oyo, Ogun)

notes: Region: Nationwide (Kano, Kaduna, Oyo, Ogun). Capsicum chinense / C. annuum (Attarugu/Shombo/Rodo).
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 1/3 K2O basal; N and remaining Potash in three side-dress splits.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O at transplanting (0 DAT). 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O at 3-4 weeks (flower bud emergence). 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O at 7-8 weeks (after first fruit flush).

source.organization: IAR Samaru, ABU Zaria; NIHORT Bagauda Sub-Station
source.title: Onion NPK recommendation Nigeria (Northern Dry Season Fadama)

notes: Region: Northern Dry Season Fadama (Kano, Sokoto, Kebbi, Borno). Stop N 3 weeks before harvest.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, all K2O, and 1/3 N basal before transplanting; remaining N in two equal splits. Stop N 3 weeks before harvest.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N at transplanting (0 DAT). 1/3 N at 21 DAT. 1/3 N at 42 DAT (bulb enlargement).

source.organization: NIHORT Ibadan; IAR Samaru, Zaria; TOGAN Extension Guides
source.title: Tomato NPK recommendation Nigeria (Northern Irrigated Valleys & South)

notes: Region: Northern Irrigated Valleys (Kano, Kaduna, Katsina, Jigawa) & South.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 1/2 K2O in transplanting pits; N and remaining Potash side-dressed in two splits during fruit development.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N + 50% K2O at transplanting (0 DAT). 1/3 N at 21 DAT (flowering). 1/3 N + 50% K2O at 42 DAT (fruit expansion).

source.organization: Oregon State University; Washington State University Extension
source.title: OSU Commercial Vegetable Production Guides

notes: Region: Pacific Northwest (Washington/Oregon). Starter N only; symbiotic N fixation via nodulation. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: 100% fertilizer banded 5 cm to the side and 5 cm below seed at planting to avoid seedling burn. Excess N causes vine overgrowth and lodging.
applicationTiming: 100% basal banded at planting (0 DAS).

source.organization: UC Agriculture and Natural Resources; WSU Extension
source.title: Carrot Production in California (UC ANR Pub 7226)

notes: Region: California / Washington. High K2O for root shape. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 1/3 K2O pre-plant banded. N and remaining K2O water-run (water-injected) or side-dressed in multiple splits for straight smooth roots.
applicationTiming: 25% N + 100% P2O5 + 35% K2O pre-plant/at planting (0 DAS). 35% N at 30 DAS post-thinning. 40% N + 65% K2O during root expansion (55-75 DAS).

source.organization: University of Idaho Extension; WSU Extension; UW-Madison Extension
source.title: Potato Nutrient Management (CIS 1058)

notes: Region: Pacific Northwest (Idaho/Washington) / Wisconsin. SOP strictly preferred for chipping and high specific gravity. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Banded starter 5 cm beside and below seed pieces at planting (30% N, full P, 40% K). Remaining N and K via sprinkler chemigation/fertigation from tuber initiation through bulking.
applicationTiming: 30% N + 100% P2O5 + 40% K2O at planting (0 DAS). 40% N + 30% K2O at tuber initiation (35-50 DAS). 30% N + 30% K2O at bulking (55-80 DAS); cease 2-3 weeks before vine killing.

source.organization: OSU Extension Service; Texas A&M AgriLife
source.title: Nutrient Management for Onions in the PNW (EM 9037)

notes: Region: Pacific Northwest (Treasure Valley/Columbia Basin) / Georgia / Texas. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Pre-plant band of P, K, S and 20-30% N. Remaining N via drip or sidedress between 2-leaf and 6-leaf stages. Halt late N at bulb initiation to prevent neck rot and storage decay.
applicationTiming: Pre-plant bed incorporation (0 DAS). Split 1 at 2-3 leaf stage (35-45 DAS). Split 2 at 5-6 leaf stage (60-75 DAS); strictly complete before bulb initiation.

source.organization: UC Agriculture and Natural Resources; UC Davis VRIC
source.title: Spinach Production (UC ANR Pub 7212)

notes: Region: California (Salinas Valley, Imperial Valley). Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Pre-plant band injection (anti-leaching). All P2O5, K2O and 30% N at bedding; remaining N in 2 splits with sprinkler/drip irrigation.
applicationTiming: 30% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O pre-plant (0 DAS). 35% N at first true leaf (14-18 DAS). 35% N at rapid growth (25-28 DAS, 10 days before harvest).

source.organization: UC Davis VRIC; Western Fertilizer Handbook
source.title: Cauliflower Production in California

notes: Region: California Central Coast (Salinas/Santa Maria). Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Banded starter at transplanting (20% N + full P + half K). Balance N and K via drip fertigation during vegetative expansion and curd development.
applicationTiming: Starter basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Sidedress/fertigation split 1 at 20-25 DAT. Split 2 at rapid canopy closure and button stage (40-50 DAT).

source.organization: UF/IFAS Extension; Cornell University Vegetable Guidelines
source.title: Cole Crop Production in Florida (HS725)

notes: Region: Florida / California / New York. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Pre-plant broadcast/incorporated P2O5 and K2O. Nitrogen in 3 equal splits (cultivate/fertigate) to prevent head cracking.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O pre-plant/transplant (0 DAT). 1/3 N at 20-25 DAT. 1/3 N + 50% K2O at cupping/head initiation (40-45 DAT).

source.organization: UF/IFAS Extension; UC Davis VRIC
source.title: Radish Production Guide

notes: Region: Florida / California. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Fast 21-28 day crop. 100% NPK pre-plant incorporated into bed lines; on sand soils single top-dress at 10-12 days.
applicationTiming: 100% pre-plant (0 DAS), or on sand soils 50% pre-plant + 50% sidedressed at 12 DAS.

source.organization: UC Agriculture and Natural Resources; WSU Extension
source.title: Carrot Production in California (UC ANR Pub 7226)

notes: Region: California (Kern County/San Joaquin Valley). Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 1/3 K2O pre-plant banded. N and remaining K2O water-run or side-dressed in multiple splits for straight smooth roots.
applicationTiming: 25% N + 100% P2O5 + 35% K2O pre-plant/at planting (0 DAS). 35% N at 30 DAS post-thinning. 40% N + 65% K2O during root expansion (55-75 DAS).

source.organization: UF/IFAS Extension; University of Georgia Extension
source.title: Eggplant Production (HS728)

notes: Region: Florida / Georgia / New Jersey / California. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Plasticulture with drip. Pre-plant incorporated bed starter (25% N, full P, 25% K). Remainder injected weekly via drip by crop stage.
applicationTiming: Pre-plant bed basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Ramp-up early vegetative to first flower (20-45 DAT). Peak delivery fruit enlargement to multiple pickings (50-90 DAT).

source.organization: UC Agriculture and Natural Resources; UC Davis VRIC
source.title: Garlic Production in California (UC ANR Pub 7215)

notes: Region: California (Gilroy, Central Valley). Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Pre-plant band of P, K, S and 20% N. Remaining N in 3 equal splits with furrow/drip irrigation at spring green-up. Halt N at bulb expansion (late April/early May).
applicationTiming: 20% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O at autumn planting (Oct/Nov). 40% N at vegetative spring restart (Feb/early Mar). 40% N at rapid canopy stage (late Mar/early Apr); halt 4-6 weeks before harvest.

source.organization: UF/IFAS Extension; UC Davis VRIC
source.title: Pepper Production in Florida (HS732)

notes: Region: Florida / California / New Mexico. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Under plastic mulch: all P and 20% N/K in pre-plant bedding. Remainder via drip line proportionally across the 12-week harvest window.
applicationTiming: Pre-plant bed foundation at transplanting (0 DAT). Vegetative fertigation weeks 2-4 post-transplant. Flowering to harvest continuous injection weeks 5-12.

source.organization: UC Agriculture and Natural Resources; UF/IFAS Extension
source.title: Processing Tomato Guidelines; Tomato Production in Florida (HS739)

notes: Region: California Central Valley / Florida. K2O critical for fruit quality and blossom end rot suppression. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Starter band at transplanting (15-20% N, full P, 20% K). 75-80% N and K fertigated per plant uptake curve; peak delivery at first pink fruit stage.
applicationTiming: Pre-plant bed basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Weeks 2-5 post-transplant: vegetative to early flower ramp-up. Weeks 6-11: heavy fruit sizing and ripening injection.

source.organization: Embrapa Hortaliças (Manual Técnico da Cultura da Ervilha); IAC Boletim 100
source.title: Peas (Ervilha) NPK recommendation Brazil

notes: Region: Minas Gerais, São Paulo & Paraná (Subtropical / Southern Plateau). Starter N only (biological N2 fixation via Rhizobium leguminosarum bv. viciae). Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: 100% NPK in sowing furrow as localized band below the seed. Excess N blocks nodulation and causes vegetative overgrowth.
applicationTiming: 100% basal banded at sowing (0 DAE).

source.organization: IAC Boletim 100; Embrapa Hortaliças
source.title: Radish (Rabanete) NPK recommendation Brazil

notes: Region: São Paulo & Rio de Janeiro green belts. Short 25-day cycle. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, K2O, and 50% N incorporated at planting; remaining N as a single light top-dress at 12-15 DAE.
applicationTiming: 50% N + all P+K at sowing (0 DAE). 50% N 12-15 days after emergence.

source.organization: IFAPA Andalucía; MAPA
source.title: Okra NPK recommendation Spain

notes: Region: Andalucía (Almería/Málaga coast) & Murcia. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 20% N/K2O incorporated as basal (abonado de fondo). Remaining N and K2O split via drip fertigation during vegetative expansion and continuous pod harvest.
applicationTiming: Basal at seeding (0 DAS). Fertigation stage 1: vegetative growth (20-40 DAS). Fertigation stage 2: flowering to multiple harvest flushes (45-90 DAS).

source.organization: MAPA; ITAP Albacete
source.title: Garlic NPK recommendation Spain

notes: Region: Castilla-La Mancha (Cuenca/Albacete), Andalucía (Córdoba). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: All P2O5, K2O, sulphur and 25% N as basal (abonado de fondo). Remaining N in two equal spring top-dresses. Stop N at bulb differentiation.
applicationTiming: Basal at planting (November/December). Top-dress 1: vegetative restart (late Feb/early Mar). Top-dress 2: pre-bulb swelling (early Apr; halt 30 days before harvest).

source.organization: ITACyL; MAPA
source.title: Potato NPK recommendation Spain

notes: Region: Castilla y León, Galicia, Andalucía (Sevilla early). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 50% N/K2O at planting in furrow ridging. Remaining N and K2O at earthing-up (aporcado) or tuber initiation via fertigation.
applicationTiming: 50% N + all P2O5 + 50% K2O at planting (0 DAP). 50% N + 50% K2O at earthing-up / tuber initiation (30-35 DAP).

source.organization: CREA-OF Pontecagnano; Regione Sicilia
source.title: Okra NPK recommendation Italy (Sicilia/Campania/Puglia)

notes: Region: Sicilia, Campania & Puglia. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 20-25% N/K2O as basal (concimazione di fondo) incorporated in soil; remaining N and K2O via drip fertigation during flowering and continuous fruit collection.
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing/transplanting (0 DAS/DAT). Fertigation split 1: vegetative development (20-35 DAT). Fertigation split 2: flowering to harvesting cycles (40-85 DAT).

source.organization: Consorzio Aglio Bianco Piacentino; Emilia-Romagna
source.title: Garlic NPK recommendation Italy (Emilia-Romagna/Veneto)

notes: Region: Emilia-Romagna (Piacenza/Ferrara), Veneto (Polesano DOP). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: All P2O5, K2O, Sulphur and 20% N as basal (autumn/winter); remaining N in two equal splits at spring restart. Stop all late N at bulb swelling (ingrossamento del bulbo).
applicationTiming: Basal at planting (October/November, 0 DAP). Copertura 1: vegetative restart (late February/early March). Copertura 2: pre-bulbification (early April; halt 30 days before harvest).

source.organization: BATEM Antalya; Atatürk Horticultural Central Research Institute, Yalova
source.title: Okra NPK recommendation, Turkiye

notes: Region: Aegean, Marmara & Mediterranean. Decare values: N 8-10, P2O5 5-6.5, K2O 6-8 kg/da. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, all K2O, and 1/3 N as basal (taban gubresi) incorporated into the seedbed before sowing; remaining N in two equal top-dress splits.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N at sowing (0 DAS). 1/3 N 20-25 days after emergence (hoeing stage). 1/3 N at first flowering / pod initiation (40-45 DAS).

source.organization: TAGEM; Ege University, Faculty of Agriculture
source.title: Peas NPK recommendation, Turkiye

notes: Starter N dose only; symbiotic nitrogen fixation via root nodules. Region: Marmara, Aegean & Mediterranean.
applicationMethod: 100% fertilizer as basal band placement below seed furrows at sowing.
applicationTiming: 100% basal at sowing (0 DAS).

source.organization: T.C. Tarim ve Orman Bakanligi; BATEM Antalya
source.title: Spinach NPK recommendation, Turkiye

notes: Region: Aegean, Marmara, Central Anatolia. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, K2O, and 50% N as basal; remaining N top-dressed at 4-5 leaf stage. Stop N 15 days before harvest.
applicationTiming: 50% N + all P2O5 + all K2O at sowing (0 DAS). 50% N 20-25 days after emergence (rapid vegetative growth; stop N 15 days before harvest).

source.organization: Atatürk Horticultural Central Research Institute, Yalova; TAGEM
source.title: Cauliflower NPK recommendation, Turkiye

notes: Region: Aegean, Marmara, Mediterranean. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, boron, and 1/3 N/K2O as basal before transplanting; remaining N and K2O in two equal splits via fertigation or sidedress.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Top-dress 25-30 days after planting (vegetative growth). Top-dress at curd formation start (50-60 DAT).

source.organization: TAGEM; Samsun Black Sea Agricultural Research Institute
source.title: Cabbage NPK recommendation, Turkiye

notes: Region: Central Anatolia, Black Sea, Marmara. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 1/3 K2O as basal; N and remaining K2O in two equal post-transplant splits for a compact head and no cracking.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Top-dress 25 days after planting. Top-dress at head formation (45-55 DAT).

source.organization: East Mediterranean Agricultural Research Institute, Adana; TAGEM
source.title: Radish NPK recommendation, Turkiye

notes: Region: Mediterranean (Osmaniye/Kadirli), Aegean. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: 100% fertilizer as basal incorporated into soil before sowing (short 25-35 day root crop).
applicationTiming: 100% basal pre-sowing (0 DAS).

source.organization: Selçuk University; TTAE Ankara
source.title: Carrot NPK recommendation, Turkiye

notes: Region: Central Anatolia (Konya), Ankara. High potash prevents root cracking and improves color. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 1/3 K2O as basal; N and remaining K2O in two splits at thinning and root bulking.
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 DAS). Top-dress after thinning (30-35 DAS). Top-dress at root bulking (60-75 DAS).

source.organization: BATEM Antalya; TAGEM
source.title: Eggplant NPK recommendation, Turkiye

notes: N: 140-180 kg/ha open field; up to 250 kg/ha greenhouse (sera). Region: Mediterranean (Antalya), Aegean, Sanliurfa. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Greenhouse/drip fertigation: basal 15-20% N + full P + 20% K; remaining N and K injected weekly via fertigation during flowering and harvest.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Vegetative growth start (20-40 DAT). Flowering and continuous harvest period (45-100 DAT).

source.organization: Kastamonu University; TAGEM
source.title: Garlic NPK recommendation, Turkiye

notes: Region: Black Sea (Taskopru), Aegean, Southeast. Sulphur for allicin aroma. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, K2O, sulphur, and 1/3 N as basal; remaining N in two spring splits. Stop N 30 days before bulb formation.
applicationTiming: Basal at planting (Oct/Nov, 0 DAP). Top-dress at spring vegetative restart (early March). Top-dress pre-bulb formation (mid-April; stop 30 days before harvest).

source.organization: Potato Research Institute, Nigde; TAGEM
source.title: Potato NPK recommendation, Turkiye

notes: Region: Central Anatolia (Nigde, Nevsehir, Kayseri, Konya), Aegean. SOP (potassium sulphate) strictly preferred. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 50% N + 50% K2O in planting furrows as basal; remaining N and K2O at earthing-up / hilling (tuber initiation) via hilling or fertigation.
applicationTiming: 50% N + all P2O5 + 50% K2O at planting (0 DAP). 50% N + 50% K2O at earthing-up / tuber formation (30-40 DAP).

source.organization: BATEM Antalya; Atatürk Horticultural Central Research Institute, Yalova
source.title: Pepper NPK recommendation, Turkiye

notes: Covers sivri, kapya, dolmalik, carliston types. Region: Mediterranean (Antalya), Aegean, Marmara. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Basal 20% N + full P + 20% K; remaining N and K via drip fertigation balanced across flowering, fruit set, and harvest.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Rooting and early vegetative growth (15-35 DAT). Flowering, fruit growth and harvest (40-110 DAT).

source.organization: Polatli Commodity Exchange; TTAE Ankara
source.title: Onion NPK recommendation, Turkiye

notes: Region: Central Anatolia (Ankara/Polatli), Central Black Sea (Amasya). Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, 1/3 K2O, and 20% N as basal; remaining N and K2O in 2-3 top-dressings. Stop N completely at bulbing to prevent thick necks and rot.
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing/transplanting (0 DAS/DAT). Top-dress at 3-4 leaf stage (30-35 DAS/DAT). Top-dress at bulb initiation (60-70 DAS/DAT; stop all N 30 days before harvest).

source.organization: BATEM Antalya; ETAE Izmir; SALDER
source.title: Tomato NPK recommendation, Turkiye

notes: N: 180-240 kg/ha processing tomato; 220-280 kg/ha greenhouse. High potash for Brix and fruit firmness. Region: Mediterranean (Antalya), Marmara/Aegean. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Basal 20% N + full P + 20% K; 80% N and K via drip fertigation split across first flowering, fruit set, and ripening.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Vegetative growth (15-30 DAT). Flowering and first fruit set (35-55 DAT). Fruit sizing and ripening (60-95 DAT).

source.organization: RDA Standard Fertilization Manual (작물별 시비처방기준); NIHHS
source.title: Okra NPK recommendation South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Region: Southern coastal & Jeju Island (Jeonnam, Gyeongnam, Jeju).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, all K2O, and 1/3 N as basal incorporated before vinyl mulching. Top-dress the remaining N in two equal splits.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N at sowing/planting (0 DAS/DAP). 1/3 N 25-30 days after emergence (4-5 true-leaf stage). 1/3 N at flowering and early harvest stage (45-50 DAS).

source.organization: RDA NICS (국립식량과학원)
source.title: Peas NPK recommendation South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Region: Southern plains (Gyeongnam, Jeonnam). Starter N dose only; symbiotic N fixation via nodules.
applicationMethod: 100% NPK as basal band placement below the seed furrows before sowing. Avoid excess nitrogen, which causes vegetative overgrowth and weak pod setting.
applicationTiming: 100% basal at sowing (0 DAS).

source.organization: RDA NIHHS; Gyeongsangnam-do ARES
source.title: Spinach NPK recommendation South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Region: Open-field winter crop (Namhae, Pohang, Sinan) and protected vinyl (Gyeonggi).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, K2O, and 50% N as basal. Top-dress the remaining N at the 3-4 true-leaf stage. Stop N 15 days before harvest.
applicationTiming: 50% N + all P2O5 + all K2O at sowing (0 DAS). 50% N 15-20 days after emergence (3-4 true-leaf stage).

source.organization: RDA NIHHS (국립원예특작과학원); Highland Agriculture Research Institute
source.title: Cauliflower NPK recommendation South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Region: Jeju Island and Highland Gangwon (Jecheon, Pyeongchang).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, boron, and 1/3 N/K2O as basal before transplanting. Side-dress or fertigate the remaining N and K2O in two equal splits.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). 1st top-dressing 20-25 days after transplanting. 2nd top-dressing at curd initiation stage (45-50 DAT).

source.organization: RDA Standard Fertilization Manual; Jeju Agricultural Research & Extension Services
source.title: Cabbage NPK recommendation South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Region: Jeju (winter), Gangwon Highland (summer: Daegwallyeong), Jeonnam.
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 1/3 K2O as basal. Split N and the remaining K2O in two equal post-transplant top-dressings for uniform head formation without cracking.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). 1st top-dressing 20-25 days after transplanting (active vegetative stage). 2nd top-dressing at head formation initiation (40-50 DAT).

source.organization: RDA Standard Fertilization Manual; Highland Agriculture Research Institute
source.title: Korean radish (Mu) NPK recommendation South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Region: Nationwide (autumn Mu, spring mulch, Highland Gangwon summer Mu). Boron prevents internal browning.
applicationMethod: Incorporate all P2O5, boron, and 50% N/K2O as basal. Side-dress the remaining N and K2O 20-25 days after sowing, after thinning at root thickening stage.
applicationTiming: 50% N + all P2O5 + 50% K2O + all boron at sowing (0 DAS). 50% N + 50% K2O 20-25 days after sowing (post-thinning, root thickening).

source.organization: Jeju Agricultural Research & Extension Services; RDA NIHHS
source.title: Carrot NPK recommendation South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Region: Jeju (Gujwa winter carrot hub), Gangwon (Pyeongchang).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 1/3 K2O as basal. Split N and the remaining K2O into two top-dressings at thinning and root thickening. High potash improves root shape and carotene accumulation.
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 DAS). 1st top-dressing at 3-4 true-leaf stage / after thinning (25-30 DAS). 2nd top-dressing at root bulking stage (50-60 DAS).

source.organization: RDA NIHHS (가지 표준재배법); Gyeonggi-do ARES
source.title: Eggplant NPK recommendation South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Region: Gyeonggi (Yeoju), Gangwon (Chuncheon), Gyeongnam. Protected cultivation N up to 220 kg/ha.
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 25% N/K2O as basal. Deliver the remaining N and K via drip fertigation or 3-4 post-transplant side-dressings through the continuous harvest period.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). 1st top-dressing 25-30 days after transplanting (first flower opening). 2nd and 3rd top-dressings at 20-25 day intervals during continuous harvesting.

source.organization: RDA NIHHS (마늘 표준재배 및 시비기준); Uiseong Garlic Research Institute
source.title: Garlic NPK recommendation South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Region: Southern coastal (Namhae, Goheung, Jeju) and northern inland (Uiseong, Danyang, Seosan).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, sulphur, and 1/3 N/K2O as basal at autumn planting. Split the remaining N and K2O into two equal spring top-dressings. Strictly stop all N by end of March to prevent secondary growth (벌마늘).
applicationTiming: Basal at planting (October/November, 0 DAP). 1st top-dressing at spring regrowth start (mid to late February). 2nd top-dressing mid to late March.

source.organization: RDA Highland Agriculture Research Institute (고령지농업연구소)
source.title: Potato NPK recommendation South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Region: Gangwon (Pyeongchang, Gangneung), Chungnam (Dangjin), Jeonbuk (Gimje). SOP strictly preferred for starch content.
applicationMethod: Under vinyl mulch cultivation, apply 100% NPK as full basal (전량기비) in the sowing furrow below the seed, covered with soil and plastic mulch.
applicationTiming: 100% basal at planting under mulch (0 DAP).

source.organization: RDA NIHHS (고추 표준재배지침); Yeongyang Pepper Research Institute
source.title: Hot red pepper (Gochu) NPK recommendation South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Region: Nationwide (Andong, Yeongyang, Goesan, Jeongeup).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 40% N/K2O as basal during ridge formation. Split the remaining N and K2O into three post-transplant side-dressings (furrow application).
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). 1st top-dressing 25-30 days after transplanting (first fruit set). 2nd top-dressing 30 days later (55-60 DAT). 3rd top-dressing 30 days after that (85-90 DAT, continuous red ripening).

source.organization: Jeollanam-do ARES (Muan Onion Research Institute); RDA NIHHS
source.title: Onion NPK recommendation South Korea

notes: Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Region: Jeonnam (Muan, Sinan), Gyeongnam (Changnyeong, Hamyang). Autumn-sown / spring-harvest.
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 1/3 N/K2O as basal before autumn transplanting. Split the remaining N and K2O into two equal spring top-dressings. Stop all N before April to avoid storage rot and soft necks.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (October/November, 0 DAT). 1st top-dressing mid to late February. 2nd top-dressing mid to late March.

source.organization: MARDI (Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute)
source.title: Peas (Kacang Pis) NPK recommendation Malaysia — Highland zones

notes: Region: Cameron Highlands (Pahang) & Kundasang (Sabah). Starter N only; symbiotic nitrogen fixation. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: 100% fertilizer as basal before sowing via band placement 5 cm to the side and below the seed line. Excess nitrogen causes vine overgrowth and poor pod set.
applicationTiming: 100% basal at planting (0 HST).

source.organization: MARDI (Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute)
source.title: Spinach (Bayam) NPK recommendation Malaysia

notes: Region: Lowland vegetable belts (Selangor, Johor, Kelantan). Short 25-30 day cycle. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All Phosphorus, all Potash, and 1/2 Nitrogen as basal on beds. Remaining Nitrogen 12-14 days later via liquid fertigation drench or side-dress.
applicationTiming: 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O at sowing (0 HST). 50% N at 12-14 HST.

source.organization: MARDI (Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute)
source.title: Cauliflower (Kobis Bunga) NPK recommendation Malaysia

notes: Region: Cameron Highlands (Pahang), Kundasang (Sabah) & lowland F1 hybrids. Boron essential for browning/hollow stem prevention. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, Boron, and 1/3 N/K2O as basal on beds. Remaining N and K2O in two equal splits via pocket application or fertigation.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 HST). 1st top-dress at 20-25 HST. 2nd top-dress at curd formation (45-50 HST).

source.organization: MARDI (Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute)
source.title: Cabbage (Kobis Bulat) NPK recommendation Malaysia

notes: Region: Cameron Highlands (Pahang) & Kundasang (Sabah). Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 1/3 K2O basal. Nitrogen and remaining K2O in two equal post-transplant splits for solid heads and crack prevention.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 HST). 1st top-dress at 20-25 HST. 2nd top-dress at head formation (40-50 HST).

source.organization: MARDI (Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute)
source.title: Radish (Lobak Putih) NPK recommendation Malaysia

notes: Region: Cameron Highlands & lowland river basins. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, K2O, and 1/2 N incorporated into beds at sowing. Remaining N side-dressed at root thickening.
applicationTiming: 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O at sowing (0 HST). 50% N at 20-25 HST (root enlargement).

source.organization: MARDI (Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute)
source.title: Carrot (Lobak Merah) NPK recommendation Malaysia

notes: Region: Cameron Highlands & Kundasang. High potash for root straightness and carotene. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 1/3 K2O basal. Nitrogen and remaining K2O in two splits at thinning and root bulking.
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 HST). 1st top-dress at thinning (25-30 HST). 2nd top-dress at root bulking (50-60 HST).

source.organization: MARDI (Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute)
source.title: Brinjal (Terung) NPK recommendation Malaysia

notes: Region: Nationwide (Johor, Perak, Selangor, Sabah, Sarawak). Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: Phosphorus and Potash basal in planting holes. Nitrogen in three equal splits over the long harvest season (open field or polybag fertigation).
applicationTiming: 1/3 N at transplanting (0 HST). 1/3 N at 25-30 HST (flowering start). 1/3 N at 55-60 HST (harvest stage).

source.organization: MARDI (Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute)
source.title: Garlic (Bawang Putih) NPK recommendation Malaysia

notes: Region: Highland microclimates (Cameron Highlands). Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5, K2O, Sulphur, and 1/3 N basal on beds. Remaining N in two splits. Stop Nitrogen 30 days before harvest.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N at planting (0 HST). 1/3 N at 25-30 HST. 1/3 N at 50-55 HST (clove formation).

source.organization: Jabatan Pertanian Malaysia (DOA)
source.title: Potato (Ubi Kentang) NPK recommendation Malaysia — Highland belts

notes: Region: Kundasang (Sabah) & Cameron Highlands (Pahang). High P fixation in acidic mountain soils; SOP preferred. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 50% N/K2O in planting furrows. Remaining N and K2O side-dressed at earthing-up (tuber initiation).
applicationTiming: 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O at planting (0 HST). 50% N + 50% K2O at 30-35 HST (earthing-up/tuber initiation).

source.organization: MARDI (Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute)
source.title: Chili (Cili Merah) NPK recommendation Malaysia — Fertigation guide

notes: Region: Nationwide (polybag fertigation & open field). Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 20% N/K2O basal on beds. Remainder in 3-4 splits via pocket application or fertigation (MARDI AB formulation for fertigation systems).
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 HST). 1st top-dress at 20-25 HST (vegetative). 2nd at 45-50 HST (flowering). 3rd at 70-90 HST (continuous harvest).

source.organization: MARDI (Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute)
source.title: Shallot (Bawang Merah) NPK recommendation Malaysia — BAWANG-1 & BAWANG-2

notes: Region: Lowland trial belts (Perak, Kelantan, Selangor) — MARDI local shallot initiative. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 50% K2O basal on beds. Nitrogen and remaining K2O in two equal splits. Stop Nitrogen completely after 35 HST (bulb formation start).
applicationTiming: 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O at planting (0 HST). 50% N at 10-14 HST. 50% N + 50% K2O at 25-28 HST (bulb enlargement).

source.organization: MARDI (Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute)
source.title: Tomato NPK recommendation Malaysia — Cameron Highlands

notes: Region: Cameron Highlands (Pahang) & lowland fertigation shelters. High potash for fruit firmness and blossom end rot prevention. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 30% K2O basal. Nitrogen and remaining K2O in 3-4 splits during flowering and fruit enlargement (injected/side-dressed).
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 HST). 1st top-dress at 20-25 HST (early flowering). 2nd at 40-45 HST (first fruit formation). 3rd at 60-75 HST (fruit enlargement/ripening).

source.organization: MARDI (Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute)
source.title: Okra (Bendi) NPK recommendation Malaysia

notes: Region: Peninsular Malaysia (Johor, Perak, Selangor), Sabah & Sarawak. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). TSP and MOP basis.
applicationMethod: All Phosphorus, all Potash, and 1/3 Nitrogen as basal fertilizer incorporated into raised beds (batas) in planting holes at sowing. Remaining Nitrogen in two equal top-dress splits.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N at sowing/planting (0 HST). 1/3 N at 20-25 HST. 1/3 N at flowering/first picking (40-45 HST).

source.organization: CAAS IVF; MARA
source.title: Okra NPK recommendation China

notes: Region: Shandong, Hebei, Henan & southern provinces. Per-mu: N 6.0-8.0, P2O5 3.3-4.7, K2O 4.0-6.0 kg/mu. Oxide forms confirmed (TSP/SOP basis).
applicationMethod: All P2O5, K2O and 1/3 N as basal (jifei) in seedbed; remaining N in 2 equal splits as top-dress/drip fertigation.
applicationTiming: 1/3 N at sowing (0 DAS). 1/3 N at 25-30 DAS (vegetative). 1/3 N at 45-50 DAS (flowering/first pod setting).

source.organization: MARA NATESC; CAAS
source.title: Peas NPK recommendation China

notes: Region: Sichuan, Yunnan, Gansu, Hebei. Per-mu: N 2.0-3.0, P2O5 4.0-5.3, K2O 3.0-4.3 kg/mu. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: 100% fertilizer as full basal (jifei), band-placed below seed in furrow at sowing. Excess N causes vine lodging and weak pod set; symbiotic rhizobial N-fixation.
applicationTiming: 100% basal at sowing (0 DAS).

source.organization: SAAS; NATESC
source.title: Radish NPK recommendation China

notes: Region: Shandong (Weifang/Shouguang), Henan, Sichuan. Per-mu: N 5.3-7.3, P2O5 3.0-4.3, K2O 6.0-8.7 kg/mu. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 50% N/K2O as basal at ridge formation; remaining N and K2O side-dressed at taproot swelling.
applicationTiming: 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O at sowing (0 DAS). 50% N + 50% K2O at 25-30 DAS (taproot swelling).

source.organization: MARA; IVF-CAAS
source.title: Eggplant NPK recommendation China

notes: Region: Shandong, Liaoning, Guangdong, Hebei. N open-field 160-210; solar greenhouse up to 260. Per-mu: P2O5 4.7-6.3, K2O 9.3-12.7 kg/mu. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 25% N/K2O as basal; remaining N and K via drip fertigation or 3-4 post-transplant side-dressings through harvest.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). First fruit setting (25-30 DAT): 25% N + 25% K2O. Peak fruiting flush (50-90 DAT): remaining 50% N and K2O in 2 equal splits.

source.organization: Gansu Academy of Agricultural Sciences; MARA NATESC
source.title: Onion NPK recommendation China

notes: Region: Gansu (Hexi Corridor), Shandong, Jiangsu, Sichuan. Per-mu: N 9.3-12.0, P2O5 4.3-5.7, K2O 7.3-10.0 kg/mu. Oxide forms confirmed.
applicationMethod: All P2O5 and 1/3 N/K2O as basal before transplanting; remaining N and K2O in 2 equal splits. Stop all N after bulb bulking to avoid thick necks and decay; halt N 30 days before harvest.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Spring green-up/post-transplant recovery (30-35 DAT): 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O. Bulb expansion initiation (60-70 DAT): 1/3 N + 1/3 K2O.

source.organization: Kagoshima Prefectural Agricultural Experiment Station; MAFF
source.title: Okra NPK recommendation Japan

notes: Region: Kyushu (Kagoshima, Kochi, Okinawa). Per-10a: N 12.0-16.0, P2O5 8.0-11.0, K2O 10.0-14.0 kg/10a. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply 40% N, all P2O5 and all K2O as basal (genpi) incorporated before mulching. Split remaining N in two equal top-dressings (oibai) during the long picking period.
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing/planting (0 DAS): 40% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O. Top-dress 1: first flower opening (30-35 DAS): 30% N. Top-dress 2: peak harvest flush (55-60 DAS): 30% N.

source.organization: Wakayama Prefectural Agriculture and Forestry Experiment Station; NARO
source.title: Snow/green peas NPK recommendation Japan

notes: Region: Kagoshima, Wakayama, Aichi. Starter N only (symbiotic rhizobial N-fixation). Per-10a: N 4.0-6.0, P2O5 8.0-11.0, K2O 5.0-7.0 kg/10a. High P for volcanic ash (Andosol) soils. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply 100% fertilizer localized as full basal (genpi) on prepared beds before sowing. Excessive nitrogen causes tsuruboke (excessive vegetative growth, poor pod set).
applicationTiming: 100% basal at sowing (0 DAS / zenryo genpi seyo).

source.organization: Aichi Prefectural Agricultural Research Center; MAFF
source.title: Cauliflower NPK recommendation Japan

notes: Region: Tokushima, Aichi, Nagano. Per-10a: N 16.0-20.0, P2O5 12.0-16.0, K2O 13.0-17.0 kg/10a. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, Boron, and 1/2 N/K2O as basal before transplanting (teishoku). Apply remaining N and K2O in two equal top-dressings (oibai).
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT): 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O. Top-dress 1: vegetative rosette stage (20-25 DAT): 25% N + 25% K2O. Top-dress 2: curd initiation stage / karai keisei shiki (45-50 DAT): 25% N + 25% K2O.

micronutrients.boron: 1.5-2.0 kg/ha (brown curd and hollow stem prevention)

source.organization: Aomori Prefectural Industrial Technology Research Center, Agriculture Research Institute; MAFF
source.title: Garlic NPK recommendation Japan (Fukuchi White Six-Tooth)

notes: Region: Aomori (Takko, Towada, Hachinohe), Hokkaido. Per-10a: N 16.0-20.0, P2O5 15.0-20.0, K2O 14.0-18.0 kg/10a. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, Sulphur, and 1/2 N/K2O as basal (genpi) at autumn planting. Split remaining N and K2O in two equal top-dressings at spring regrowth after snow-melt (haru no hoga-ki). Stop all late N at bulb bulking start to avoid secondary sprouting.
applicationTiming: Basal at planting (late September-October): 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O. Top-dress 1: spring regrowth / yusetsu-go hoga-ki (late March-early April): 25% N + 25% K2O. Top-dress 2: pre-bulbing / chudai-mae (late April; halt all N before mid-May): 25% N + 25% K2O.

source.organization: Hokkaido Research Organization (HRO) Agriculture; Tokachi Agricultural Experiment Station
source.title: Potato NPK recommendation Japan (Danshaku, May Queen, Toyoshiro)

notes: Region: Hokkaido (Tokachi, Abashiri, Yotei), Nagasaki, Kagoshima. Processing starch up to 130 kg/ha N. Per-10a: N 9.0-12.0, P2O5 14.0-20.0, K2O 10.0-15.0 kg/10a. Heavy P compensates volcanic ash Kuroboku fixation; SOP strictly preferred for dry matter and starch. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: In Hokkaido mechanized production, apply 100% NPK as a single full basal (baido-mae zenryo genpi) at sowing via potato planter band placement, 5 cm to the side and 5 cm below the seed piece.
applicationTiming: 100% basal at planting (0 DAP / ue-tsuke-ji zenryo sehi).

source.organization: DLR Rheinpfalz (Gartenbau); KTBL Freilandgemüsebau
source.title: Okra NPK recommendation Germany

notes: Region: warm viticultural river valleys (Rheinhessen, Pfalz) & greenhouse tunnels. Germany: N is the N-Sollwert (total target crop N demand including soil Nmin; DuV requires subtracting mineralized soil nitrate-N). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Incorporate all P2O5, all K2O and 40% N as basal (Grundduengung) at seedbed preparation. Apply remaining N as top-dress/drip fertigation during flowering and continuous pod harvest.
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing/planting (0 DAS): 40% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O. Top-dress 1 (vegetative growth, 25-30 DAS): 30% N. Top-dress 2 (early flowering/fruiting, 45-50 DAS): 30% N.

source.organization: LfL Bayern (Institut fuer Erwerbs- und Freizeitgartenbau); LWK NRW
source.title: Brinjal NPK recommendation Germany

notes: Region: protected greenhouse/plastic tunnel belts (Knoblauchsland Nuernberg, Papenburg, Straelen). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 20% N/K2O as basal at planting; deliver the remaining N and K evenly via drip fertigation through the continuous harvest window.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT): 20% N + 100% P2O5 + 20% K2O. Fertigation ramp-up (vegetative growth to first fruit set, 25-45 DAT). Continuous harvest nutrition: fortnightly injections across 50-110 DAT.

source.organization: KTBL Datensammlung Gemüsebau; DLR Rheinpfalz
source.title: Chili NPK recommendation Germany

notes: Region: protected production (Baden-Wuerttemberg, Bayern, NRW). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply 20% N + all P2O5 + 20% K2O as basal (Grundduengung); split the remaining N and K via drip fertigation across vegetative expansion, flowering and continuous fruiting.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Establishment/vegetative growth (15-30 DAT). Flowering and fruit development (35-95 DAT).

source.organization: KTBL Freiland- und Gewächshausgemüsebau; LWK Nordrhein-Westfalen
source.title: Tomato NPK recommendation Germany

notes: Region: commercial glasshouse/greenhouse hubs (NRW, Bayern, Brandenburg). High potash for Brix, fruit firmness and blossom-end rot control. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply 20% N + full P2O5 + 20% K2O as basal (Grundduengung); inject 80% of N and K via drip fertigation in weekly balanced cycles from the 1st truss through fruit growth and ripening.
applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Establishment and 1st truss flowering (15-30 DAT). Fruit load and ripening (35-100 DAT; regular fertigation cycles).

source.organization: CTIFL; Chambre d'Agriculture PACA
source.title: Okra NPK recommendation France

notes: Region: Sud-Est / PACA (Provence-Alpes-Cote d'Azur) and protected tunnels. France: N values are total crop nutritional target doses (COMIFER bilan previsionnel X kg/ha); soil mineral reserve (Ri / reliquat azote sortie hiver) must be subtracted per COMIFER/Nitrates Directive. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 25% N/K2O as fumure de fond (basal) incorporated under plastic mulch/drip; split the remaining N and K2O in fertigated fractions during vegetative expansion and continuous harvesting.
applicationTiming: Fumure de fond at sowing/transplanting (0 DAS/DAT). Fraction 1: vegetative growth (20-35 DAT). Fraction 2: flowering and successive harvests (40-85 DAT).

source.organization: Chambre d'Agriculture d'Alsace; COMIFER
source.title: Cabbage NPK recommendation France

notes: Region: Grand Est (Alsace - choucroute production), Hauts-de-France, Bretagne. France: N values are total crop nutritional target doses (COMIFER bilan previsionnel X kg/ha); soil mineral reserve (Ri / reliquat azote sortie hiver) must be subtracted per COMIFER/Nitrates Directive. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 1/2 K2O as basal (fumure de fond); split N and the remaining K2O in two post-transplant applications so heading (pommaison) is dense and splitting (eclatement) is avoided.
applicationTiming: Fumure de fond (0 DAT): 40% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O. 1st top-dress (vegetative recovery, 20-25 DAT): 30% N + 25% K2O. 2nd top-dress (heading initiation / debut pommaison, 45-55 DAT): 30% N + 25% K2O.

source.organization: InHort Skierniewice; IUNG-PIB Pulawy
source.title: Okra NPK recommendation Poland

notes: Poland: N values are total crop nutritional target doses; mineral soil nitrogen reserves (Nmin, 0-60 cm depth) must be deducted from the total per the Polish Program Azotanowy / EU Nitrates Directive. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, all K2O, and 40% N as basal (nawozenie przedsiewne) incorporated at seedbed preparation; remaining N as top-dress (nawozenie poglowne, top-dress/drip) during vegetative expansion and continuous pod harvesting.
applicationTiming: Basal at sowing/planting (0 DAS/DAP). Top-dress (vegetative growth, 25-30 DAS). Top-dress (early flowering, 45-50 DAS).

source.organization: Queensland DAF; NT Department of Industry, Tourism and Trade
source.title: Okra NPK recommendation Australia

notes: Region: Queensland (Bowen, Burdekin), Northern Territory (Darwin Rural). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O; TSP and SOP basis).
applicationMethod: Under plastic mulch with trickle/drip fertigation: band all P and 20-30% N/K pre-plant at bed formation; split remaining N and K in weekly fertigation through continuous pod-picking flushes.
applicationTiming: Pre-plant basal at sowing (0 DAS). Vegetative growth stage (20-35 DAS): 35% N + 35% K. Flowering and continuous pod harvest (40-85 DAS): 40% N + 40% K.

source.organization: Tasmanian Institute of Agriculture (TIA); Agriculture Victoria
source.title: Peas NPK recommendation Australia

notes: Region: Tasmania (major processing hub), Victoria, South Australia. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Starter N only - symbiotic rhizobial N-fixation.
applicationMethod: Apply 100% fertiliser pre-plant via seed drill, banded 5 cm to the side and 5 cm below the seed. Excess N causes vine overgrowth and reduces pod set (rhizobial N-fixation supplies the rest).
applicationTiming: 100% basal banded at sowing (0 DAS).

source.organization: Hort Innovation Australia; Agriculture Victoria
source.title: Spinach NPK recommendation Australia

notes: Region: Victoria (Lindenow / Gippsland, Werribee), Queensland (Lockyer Valley). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Baby leaf & bunching spinach.
applicationMethod: Short 28-35 day cycle: incorporate all P, K and 40% N pre-plant at bed preparation; side-dress or fertigate remaining N at the 2-leaf stage via overhead boom or drip.
applicationTiming: Pre-plant basal at sowing (0 DAS): 40% N + full P + full K. Sidedress / fertigation (14-18 DAS): 60% N (cease N 10 days before harvest).

source.organization: DPIRD Western Australia; Agriculture Victoria
source.title: Cauliflower NPK recommendation Australia

notes: Region: Victoria (Werribee South), Western Australia (Manjimup), Queensland (Granite Belt). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Boron for hollow stem prevention.
applicationMethod: Apply all P, Boron and 25% N/K pre-plant at bedding; split remaining N and K across two side-dressings or weekly fertigation.
applicationTiming: Pre-plant basal at transplanting (0 DAT). 1st sidedress at active vegetative frame expansion (20-25 DAT): 35% N + 35% K. 2nd sidedress at curd initiation / buttoning stage (45-50 DAT): 40% N + 40% K.

source.organization: Queensland DAF; Hort Innovation Australia
source.title: Cabbage NPK recommendation Australia

notes: Region: Queensland (Lockyer Valley), Victoria, Western Australia (Myalup). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). Head, savoy and red cabbage.
applicationMethod: Apply all P and 1/2 K as basal; split N and remaining K in two equal post-transplant splits so heads form solid without cracking.
applicationTiming: Pre-plant basal at transplanting (0 DAT): 35% N + full P + 50% K. 1st sidedress (20-25 DAT): 35% N + 25% K. 2nd sidedress at head formation initiation (45-55 DAT): 30% N + 25% K.

source.organization: Agriculture Victoria; Hort Innovation Australia
source.title: Radish NPK recommendation Australia

notes: Region: Victoria (Melbourne peri-urban), South Australia (Virginia Plains). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O).
applicationMethod: Fast 21-30 day cycle: incorporate 100% NPK pre-sowing during bed preparation.
applicationTiming: 100% basal pre-sowing (0 DAS).

source.organization: Queensland DAF; NSW Department of Primary Industries
source.title: Brinjal NPK recommendation Australia

notes: Region: Queensland (Bowen / Bundaberg), NSW (Sydney Basin), SA (Virginia). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). N variants: 140-180 field plasticulture; 200-240 protected greenhouse.
applicationMethod: Trickle fertigation under plastic mulch: apply 25% N + full P + 25% K at pre-plant bedding; inject balance N and K weekly from flowering through continuous harvesting.
applicationTiming: Pre-plant basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Vegetative to early flowering ramp-up (20-45 DAT). Peak production and harvest (50-100 DAT; regular fertigation cycles).

source.organization: Hort Innovation Australia; Potatoes South Australia
source.title: Potato NPK recommendation Australia

notes: Region: South Australia (Mallee / Riverland), Tasmania, Victoria, WA. Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). SOP strictly preferred for specific gravity. Fresh market & processing (french fry / crisping).
applicationMethod: Centre-pivot fertigation or furrow band: apply 40% N + full P + 40% K at planting; split balance N and K through pivot fertigation at tuber initiation and tuber bulking.
applicationTiming: Pre-plant banded at planting (0 DAP): 40% N + full P + 40% K. Tuber initiation stage (30-45 DAP): 35% N + 30% K. Tuber bulking stage (55-75 DAP): 25% N + 30% K (cease 3 weeks before vine desiccation).

source.organization: Queensland DAF; Bowen Gumlu Growers Association
source.title: Chili NPK recommendation Australia

notes: Region: Queensland (Bowen / Burdekin - major winter production), SA (Virginia), WA (Carnarvon). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). N variants: 160-210 field plasticulture; 220-270 protected greenhouse. Capsicum / sweet bell pepper & chili.
applicationMethod: Plasticulture with drip tape: apply 20% N + full P + 20% K at pre-plant bedding; deliver remainder via drip injection across flowering, fruit setting and harvesting flushes.
applicationTiming: Pre-plant basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Vegetative framework expansion (20-35 DAT). Fruit set to harvest maturity (40-100 DAT; weekly fertigation injections).

source.organization: Australian Processing Tomato Research Committee (APTRC); Queensland DAF; Hort Innovation Australia
source.title: Tomato NPK recommendation Australia

notes: Region: Victoria / NSW (Riverina / Echuca - processing tomato capital), Queensland (Bowen / Bundaberg - fresh staked). Oxide forms confirmed (P2O5/K2O). N variants: 170-230 processing drip; 220-280 fresh trellis/greenhouse.
applicationMethod: Buried drip tape system: apply 20% N + full P + 20% K at pre-plant bedding; inject 80% N and K via drip fertigation on a water-run schedule from 1st flower cluster to peak ripening. High potash for processing solids/Brix, fruit firmness and blossom-end rot suppression.
applicationTiming: Pre-plant basal at transplanting (0 DAT). Early vegetative establishment (15-30 DAT). Flowering to fruit sizing peak (35-75 DAT). Colour turn to harvest (75-100 DAT).
